configured_grasp_physics.scope: Measured configured supported contact only. Not calibrated material, pickup or carry acceptance.

solver.observation_scope: One-time configuration values. Iteration caps are not measured convergence counts.

scenario.scope: Instructor diagnostic ramp and contact observations, not a calibrated grasp or carry test

case_record.design_rationale: A stepped quarry fork, two relay bays, a supported canopy and a low exit ridge. Distributed mounting regions support competing left/right and two/three-arm designs.
case_record.measurement_scope: Oracle-compatible geometry record only. Not a single-arm task or proof of relay feasibility.

handling_contract.transporting_contact: Existing native finger-pad contact to the carried vessel
handling_contract.unheld_motion_rule: After loss of grasp, the body root must remain within the release neighbourhood until the next supported pickup. Final material pouring occurs only in the goal delivery region.
handling_contract.temporary_placement: Only on fixed selected supports. No movable support, conveyor, floor pushing, support repositioning or object reset.

initial_park_choice.scope: Explicit future INITIAL configuration and later retreat ENDPOINT only. No path, intermediate configuration, solved grasp q or observed state is supplied.
initial_park_choice.probe_scope: Historical R1 body geometry in an isolated nominal scene. One reversed basic single-tree search with forward validation. No source-scene or physical acceptance.
